title: Agent Query
description: AskAgent bootstrap (FDC3). Opens a session; IntentResult is a PrivateChannel. Not an AG-UI type — conversation turns after ready use fdc3.ai.agui.run / agui.event. Optional text may seed the first turn; otherwise the first utterance is sent later as agui.run.

threadId.title: Thread ID hint
threadId.description: Optional client-suggested thread id; harness may ignore and issue its own in ready.

text.title: Text
text.description: Optional user utterance for this turn. Null/omitted for session-start only.

fileIds.title: File IDs
fileIds.description: References to `fdc3.data.file` ids already delivered on this session (PrivateChannel). Omit to use all staged session files. Do not embed file bytes here.
